lead.hed: USNI: U.S. funds Subic Bay shipyard repair expansion
lead.insight: USNI News, Monday from Manila: Washington is funding a project to expand maintenance and repair at a Subic Bay shipyard U.S. Navy warships already use. Subic Drydock Corporation, an American-owned firm at the former naval station, disclosed the partnership. Funding announcement, not a finished dry dock.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Marine Corps photo by Staff Sgt. Ryan Hageali · DVIDS 9647427 · Public domain · Port operations at Naval Operating Base Subic, Zambales, Philippines, April 26, 2026.

political.hed: USNI: North Korea fires missiles and attack drones at a Sea of Japan island
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: Pyongyang fired short-range ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and attack drones at an island in the Sea of Japan on Sunday as a firepower attack drill, state media said. Subunits from five artillery and missile joint units took part. State-media claim, not a U.S. battle damage assessment.

political.hed: Defense News: U.S. and South Korea to raise a Hormuz mission at talks this week
political.insight: Defense News, Monday from Manila: Seoul and Washington hold high-level security talks this week. South Korea’s Defense Ministry said the agenda includes wartime operational control, the joint defense posture, and shipbuilding. Analysts expect a possible South Korean role in the Strait of Hormuz to come up. Talks, not a deployment order.

political.hed: USNI: Houthis seize Perim Island on the Bab el-Mandeb
political.insight: USNI News, Friday: Yemen’s Houthis seized Perim Island after taking Mocha, a foothold over the Bab el-Mandeb. The same report notes U.S. and Iran trading tanker-for-warship pressure in the Red Sea.

tech.hed: Defense News: Air Force names CCA jets Vengeance and Fury
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday: Secretary Troy Meink used the names FQ-42A Vengeance and FQ-44A Fury at the Air & Space Forces Association conference and said the service intends to have at least 500 autonomous aircraft in service by 2032. Naming and a production goal, not a fielded fleet.

tech.hed: Defense News: Air Force to stand up a point-defense career field in two years
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday: Chief of Staff Gen. Ken Wilsbach said the service will field a point-defense weapons system and a new career field of point-defense airmen, operational in two years. Two senior NCOs are the first field managers. Announcement, not a manned unit today.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: Free-speech maximalism meets material-support law
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: the essay argues Americans increasingly treat any expressive act as beyond reach, including a New York Times framing of terrorism charges after an attack on an ICE facility. Argument, not a court ruling.

culture.hed: WORLD: Monday news — oil routes, Ukraine strikes, and an AI slowdown call
culture.insight: WORLD Radio, Monday: Gulf leaders try to restore oil flow, President Trump calls on Ukraine to stop hitting diesel facilities in Russia, an AI industry leader urges a slowdown in the race, and the Justice Department takes aim at cyber crime. Newscast, not a battlefield confirmation.
